desc: Implement factorial and inverse factorial precomputation up to $2 \cdot 10^6$ and the `nCr` function.
Implement `sum_paths_rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, x4, y4)` which calculates the sum of paths from all $(x,y) \in [x1, x2] \times [y1, y2]$ to all $(u,v) \in [x3, x4] \times [y3, y4]$ in $O(1)$ time.

Implement the main logic to decompose the valid region into 4 disjoint rectangles and sum the paths between all pairs of these rectangles, ensuring paths do not enter the forbidden hole $[L, R] \times [D, U]$.

Handle the "avoiding the hole" logic. Since the hole is a rectangle, paths between two valid regions that avoid the hole can be calculated as `Total_Paths - Paths_Touching_Hole`. Implement `paths_touching_hole` using inclusion-exclusion on the 4 corners of the hole.
Assemble the final solution, read input, compute the answer, and print it.
